# PONS launch planning

Base8ab79afb5b01e397ad658b82cd6524be4b3ed03a. This draft-only slice adds a PONS launch-plan panel beside launch inputs. Selected protocol supply, curve fee and launch fee are read-only context. Apply accepts exact creator tax and initial developer ETH buy, copies those two fields and invalidates any previous review. Disabled/loading/changed protocol terms, invalid custom pair or an unresolved launch operation block application. It never signs or sends a transaction or changes release gates.

Generic supply, allocation, target-price, fee and vesting simulations remain separate at the bottom after the Pro panel. They do not configure PONS or distribute/lock tokens. The later free one-wallet-per24hours request is a separate account allowance and custody review; this change does not enable it.

Root implementation exception: the requested feature-builder spawn failed with agent thread limit reached. Root used an isolated worktree; independent behavioral verification and fresh source review remain mandatory before release. Source/build/test evidence is under the coordinator’s protected verification/full-release/planning-link directory, outside published files.

Key principle: apply only supported PONS fields and require a fresh final launch review.
